gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.
